title: CPSC, Memcorp Inc. Recall of Disney®-Brand Personal DVD Players Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The battery packs sold with these DVD players can overheat and possibly burst when recharging, posing a risk of burns. Units: About 102,000.

title: Toe-Kick Saws Recalled Due to Broken Handles
summary: The saw's plastic handle can break, causing the user to lose control of the saw, which could kick back and present a laceration hazard, if the blade is in motion. Units: About 15,500.

title: Trendset Originals Recalls Girls' Sweaters with Drawstrings Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: A drawstring is threaded through the hood of the garment, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 1,700.

title: Polaris Industries Inc. Recalls Snowmobiles for Steering Hazard
summary: The fastener torque securing the starter motor to the engine crankcase may not have been accurately applied during the manufacture of these snowmobiles or during the installation of an accessory starter. title: Tap Enterprises Inc. Recalls Air Compressors Due to Fire and Electrocution Hazards
summary: An undersized power cord can overheat and pose a fire hazard. In addition, improper assembly of the power cord strain relief component and improper routing of internal conductors can cause a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 11,300.

title: Tropitone Recalls "Impressions Side Chair" for Fall Hazard
summary: The weld which holds the rear chair leg to the seat can separate from the seat, causing the chair to become unstable and possibly collapse. Units: About 950.

title: Yamaha Corp. of America Recalls Bench Sold with Digital Piano Due to Collapse Hazard
summary: On some benches, one or more bench bolts do not meet tensile strength specifications, which can result in collapse of the bench while in use, posing a risk of injury. The recall does not involve the pianos with which the benches were sold. Units: About 176.

title: Computer Desk Set Sold at Office Depot Recalled Due to Risk of Falls
summary: The seat on the chair can break and fall through during use, causing an individual to fall and suffer injuries. Units: About 6,000.

title: Rechargeable Battery Packs Sold with MAX Wireless Conference Phones Recalled for Burn Hazard
summary: These battery packs can short circuit, causing them to overheat and melt the protective plastic covering, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,200.

title: Serious Injuries Prompt Recall of Mini-Trampolines - New Instructions to Be Provided To Consumers
summary: If a person assembles the trampoline alone and the outside rail is released momentarily, the trampoline can snap back into the folded position and strike the consumer, posing a risk of serious injury. Units: About 668,000.

title: LandRoller Inc. Recalls to Repair Roller Skates
summary: The wheels on these roller skates can detach and the brakes can fail. Either one of these hazards can cause the skater to fall and suffer serious injury. Units: About 1,400 pairs.

title: Brookstone Foldable Massaging Bed Rest Recalled for Fire, Burn Hazards
summary: Electrical circuits within the bed rest can overheat, causing the back side of the product to overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard. Units: About 35,500.

title: InFocus Corp. Recalls Portable Projectors and Projector Lamps Posing Shock and Fire Hazards
summary: The units have improper wiring with inadequate insulation, which could degrade over time, posing a shock and fire hazard. Units: About 1,800 projectors and about 700 replacement lamp modules.

title: Tecumseh Engines Used on Various Power Equipment Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel line on these engines can become loose or disconnected, resulting in a fuel leak. This can pose a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 170,000 engines used on various products.

title: Bombardier Recreational Products Inc. Recalls Snowmobiles for Projectile Hazard
summary: Cracks can appear in the starter ring gears, causing ring gear fragmentation at high speeds. The debris can act as a projectile, causing injury or death to riders or bystanders. Units: About 3,600.

title: CPSC, Children's Necklaces Recalled for Lead Poisoning Hazard
summary: The recalled necklaces contain high levels of lead, posing a serious risk of lead poisoning and adverse health effects to young children. Units: About 55,000.

title: Apollo Audio-Visual Carts Recalled Due to Risk of Equipment Falling on Consumers
summary: These audio-visual carts were sold without a safety belt, which helps prevent heavy equipment from becoming unstable and falling from the cart's upper shelf. Equipment falling on nearby consumers can cause serious injuries and death. Units: About 960.

title: CPSC, Hoist Exercise Benches Recalled for Finger Entrapment Hazard
summary: The bench's front frame assembly (with the foot rest) can fail to lock into place, allowing users who grab the bench to position themselves to get their fingers entrapped between the front and back frame assemblies. This poses laceration and amputation hazards. Units: About 48,000.

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Snowmobiles Posing Fire and Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled snowmobiles fuel tank could crack and leak, allowing fuel or fuel vapors to escape, posing a fire and burn hazard. Units: About 41,000.

title: CPSC, RedMax Backpack Blowers Recalled Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Hot exhaust gases can then escape from the muffler and could melt the fuel tank or ignite grease, oil or debris around the fuel tank, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 170,000.

title: CPSC, Rocky Shoes & Boots, Inc. Announce Recall of Men's Safety-Toe Hiker Boots
summary: Product testing has demonstrated that the boots may not comply with applicable safety standards for crush and impact resistance. Consumers could suffer impact foot injuries. Units: About 1,300.

title: CPSC, Shindaiwa Inc. Announce Recall of Backpack Blowers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The backpack blower's muffler support bracket can break, creating an opening in the muffler body. Hot exhaust gases could then escape from the muffler and melt the fuel tank or ignite grease or debris around the fuel tank, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 87,000.

title: CPSC, Sycamore Kids Inc. Expands Recall Again of Mountain Buggy Jogging Strollers
summary: The handlebar can crack or break, causing the handlebar to detach while in use, posing a risk of injury to young children. Units: About 4,000.

title: Emergency Smoke Hoods Recalled for Risk of Carbon Monoxide Inhalation
summary: The emergency escape smoke hoods could fail to work properly, exposing the user to harmful carbon monoxide, which could seriously compromise their ability to escape the fire threat. Units: About 290,000 units.

title: HP Recalls Notebook Computer Batteries Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An internal failure can cause the battery to overheat and melt or char the plastic case, posing a burn and fire hazard. Units: About 4,100 (about 15,700 batteries worldwide).

title: Hair Dryers Recalled Due to Electrocution Hazard
summary: The electric hair dryer's power cord does not have an immersion protection plug. Therefore, if the hair dryer falls into water during use, it can pose a shock and/or electrocution hazard. Units: About 4,000 (14,000 hair dryers were sold in Mexico).

title: CCH Inc. Recalls Mountain Climbing Camming Anchor Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The cables that support climbers using these devices can fail, causing climbers to fall. Units: About 4,100.

title: Nordstrom Inc. Recalls Egg-Shaped Candle Holders for Fire Hazard
summary: The candle holder is constructed of plastic and could ignite if exposed to flame, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 5,300.
